object_ref.description: Canonical object reference. Acceptable typed-id kinds match the v1 resource selector kind enum (see resource-selector-grammar.md §3.1). Notably MUST NOT include 'actor_profile' (use the 'actor' selector with did pattern), nor non-canonical 'board' / 'list' / 'card' / 'subject' / 'room' kinds — board / list / swimlane / calendar bucket are Space objects and MUST use the 'space' kind together with the 'allowed_space_kinds' constraint to restrict which Space kinds the grant covers.

actor_id.description: Concrete principal / service / agent DID. v1 forbids actor:*; actor selectors MUST NOT use a wildcard subject.

match_scope.description: Selector match breadth. exact matches only the named resource; children matches immediate children; subtree matches descendants including nested children; realm_wide is valid only when realm_id is present and limits matching to the named Realm. The normative algorithm is zh/authz/resource-selector-grammar.md ?6.

allOf.$comment: resource-selector-grammar.md §3.1: notification / read_cursor selectors are realm-scoped and the object part is *-only (notification:<realm>:* / read_cursor:<realm>:*). A bare {"kind":"read_cursor"} with no realm_id would otherwise match every principal's read cursors across all Realms (see C04-07). Force realm_id and forbid a precise object id (no notification_id / read_cursor_id field exists; selection is realm-wide *-only).
resource-selector-grammar.md ?3.1/?4.2/?6: space and circle selectors are Realm-scoped in v1; wildcard space/circle selectors MUST carry realm_id to avoid cross-Realm authorization expansion.

Realm-local resource kinds always carry realm_id, including exact-id selectors. This prevents a schema-valid bare kind selector from matching every Realm and keeps authorization scope explicit in signed grant bytes.

resource-selector-grammar.md §4.8/§8.1: actor:* is forbidden and an actor selector MUST carry a concrete principal DID. Force actor_id present so a bare {"kind":"actor"} is rejected at the schema layer rather than only at the reducer (selector_actor_wildcard_forbidden).
